# Systemia Yard Bounded Runtime Extension

Capability ID: systemia-yard-runtime-extension-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: invocation_ready
Public URL: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=systemia-yard-runtime-extension-v1
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- keep this approved agent run going longer
- buy more runtime for this Yard execution
- extend this bounded build run
- give this approved execution more time

## Problem

An already-approved active Yard execution needs more runtime without receiving broader authority.

## Inputs

Authenticated owner, eligible active execution request key, requested additional seconds and optional spend cap.

## Outputs

Request-bound server quote, quote digest, payment requirement, bounded runtime entitlement, receipt and updated lease expiry.

## Pricing

Dynamic server quote only. Source defaults are not public price authority because deployment configuration can override them.

## Invocation and authority

Machine discovery/OpenAPI contract exists; settlement remains verification-gated.

Explicit purchase authorization is required. Purchased runtime changes time only and never widens execution scope, permissions, release authority or security access.

Payment authority: Runtime broker supports machine settlement, but live verifier configuration and a paid canary still require independent verification.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
